title: Remote Summer Intern
contentHtml:
公司名称：秦悅民内地法專家證人有限公司公司性质：外资企业
公司规模：50人以下公司行业：信息传输、软件和信息技术服务业
职位性质：实习职位类别：法律专业人员
学历要求：硕士招聘人数：5
工作地点：香港特别行政区
职位标签：

职位描述


Duration: 4 Weeks (flexible start date)
Stipend: HK$ 2,000/week
Work: Remote
Candidate Profile:
THU Law School| J.M. in International Arbitration Candidate (Expected graduation 2027)
| English: Fluent/Native
Strong Interests in international arbitration, comparative law, or financial regulation
Attributes: Meticulous, disciplined for remote work, and intellectually curious about PRC
law and practice
This is an exceptional opportunity to join a practice with a footprint in leading common
law jurisdictions—including Hong Kong, Singapore, London, and Australia—handling
matters before both courts of justice and international arbitral tribunals. You will receive
hands-on mentorship from our principal with over 30 years of experience, spanning
transactional and contentious work.
The role:
Conduct legal research on PRC law and financial regulations regarding their
implications for pending cases in SIAC, EWHC, and FCA
Assist in drafting foundational sections and compiling supporting exhibits for expert
reports.
How to apply:
Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter to cqin@cqmle.com
附件： CQMLE Intern.pdf
